matchups.preview: Supernova Takeover takes on ROK Navy's Finest this week. Supernova Takeover has won 2 straight in this series. At QB, Supernova Takeover is projected to outscore ROK Navy's Finest by roughly 2.5 points. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2025 Week 7, when they combined for 283.56 points.

Up next: Chig-a-Doodle-Doo and Big Dumb Sports. Chig-a-Doodle-Doo holds a 5-2 career edge over Big Dumb Sports in the regular season. If you want offense, check the archives: 2024 Week 13 saw this pair put up 322.14 points between them. At WR, Chig-a-Doodle-Doo is projected to outscore Big Dumb Sports by roughly 5.1 points.

Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 is the sentimental pick against VRDNO this week, because the numbers (82-18) sure aren't. Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 has won 2 straight in this series. Pat, Jamie, Nick, Mark, Anthony (Acap), Kodi, Dennis, and TJ all attended Delsea together for high school. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2025 Week 2, when they combined for 341.26 points. At WR, VRDNO is projected to outscore Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 by roughly 5.8 points.

Up next: theMadgician and Supernovas. This is only the second-ever meeting between theMadgician and Supernovas; theMadgician took the first. Back in 2025 Week 7, these two combined for 278.38 points -- still their high-water mark against each other. theMadgician projects for a real edge at QB this week -- about 4.4 points clear of Supernovas there.

The power rankings are not being subtle about this one: packerlove24 projects at 77% to beat Jake From State Farm. Jake From State Farm and packerlove24 have met 14 times in the regular season, with Jake From State Farm averaging 133.27 points to packerlove24's 135.26. Jake From State Farm is better known to the league as the insurance company. At WR, packerlove24 is projected to outscore Jake From State Farm by roughly 6.0 points.

Up next: Bandits and Newman’s Owen. Bandits and Newman’s Owen have met 10 times in the regular season, with Bandits averaging 131.52 points to Newman’s Owen's 127.45. These two have playoff history -- 1 meeting, most recently the 2024 championship, won by Bandits. You might know Newman’s Owen better as the charitable salad dressings.
